giris.satir: May your blade stay keen, gatekeeper! I am Master Tugrul of the Sivas iron guild; I have tempered steel on my anvil and forged weapons and mail. When the Mongol raid scattered the Sivas bazaar, I took my bellows and my young son to this pass. If you would raise a smithy, iron mine, barracks, and third-tier workshop, let us strike a bargain.

secenekler.metin: We know the renown of Sivas steel, Master Tugrul; how much coin do you ask from the village chest?
Who is the youth carrying the bellows? What are your terms for shelter and apprenticeship?

pazarlik_ucret.satir: To sink my anvil into the earth and fire the charcoal hearth, I ask twenty-two coins from the public treasury—I do not touch your personal pouch. In return, I unlock smithy, iron mine, guard barracks, and third-tier workshop knowledge for this village.

secenekler.metin: We hear the fee; what of your son and housing terms?
We grant twenty-two coins from the village chest, Master Tugrul; enter and light your forge.
Twenty-two coins is too steep for our public chest, Master Tugrul; safe travels.

pazarlik_ev_aile.satir: With me is my young son Kutlu; we are two souls and ask a sturdy roof. If your beds are full we can curl beneath the smithy awning for a night, so long as we are not forsaken. Kutlu knows the bellows; apprentice him to me in the smithy and in five nights he will be a half-master, then a full armorer.

secenekler.metin: Accepted, Master Tugrul; enter with your son Kutlu, and let him train in the smithy.
We have neither empty beds nor that much coin; seek another halt.

kabul_sonuc.satir: May our iron glow bright and our word hold fast, gatekeeper! Know this well: I forge weapons, but I do not stand night sentry on the wall with a shield. Soldiers keep the watch; Master Tugrul forges their steel.

ret_sonuc.satir: As you wish, gatekeeper. No raid is repelled with blunt axes and cracked spears; when that day comes, you will look for Tugrul of Sivas.
